title: wg: room-policy-04 §8.1.1 canUseJoinCode target role undefined
description: Suggestion. §8.1.1 (L1432-1437) requires "the join code refers to a valid target role", but JoinLink (L691-693) carries only opaque join_link<V>, and the text doesn't say which role must hold the capability. mimid uses role 0 as holder and takes the target from role 0's from_role_index=0 entry (decision mimid-1wgh.3.25). Fix: define where the role comes from.
notes:
Verified 2026-10-18 vs -06/-09/-04 (= main): PARTLY: Appendix join-code example answers capability holder (role 0); only target-role source undefined. New issue.
